lines: Strong body, steady faith. A man leads from both.
Your wife and kids are watching how you steward what God gave you.
Show up first: first in prayer, first in the work, first to serve.
Put one bad habit to death today. Build one that takes its place.
Discipline matters. The Spirit is who changes you. Do both.
Take care of your body. You have kingdom work to do.
Walk in step with the Spirit, then get your reps in.
Courage is a daily decision. Make it before breakfast.
Confess it, drop it, move forward. Grace covers the man who gets back up.
Carry a brother today. Text one man and ask how he is really doing.
Lead your home in Scripture, then lead it by example in the gym.
Strength is for serving. Be capable of carrying others.
Don't isolate. Bring it into the light.
Be faithful in the small things: water, steps, prayer, reps.
